SUMMARY: Wednesday Nov 4🚴‍♀️BIKE RIDE 🚴‍♂️Bout Time to REI, 17miles, 12-15mph
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
**WEDNESDAY Nov 4**
**Meet at Bout Time: 1:00pm**
**Start Riding: 1:15pm**

*Both Traditional and E-bikes are welcome.*

Let’s Ride north on the S. Platte/ Mary Carter Greenway Trail to REI (8.5 miles); Round Trip: 17miles
Speed: 12-15mph

This is a relatively flat trail with a slight downhill grade on the way to REI and a slight uphill grade on the way back. We’ll take a break at the patio area at REI or at a bench overlooking the river at Confluence Park. (Restrooms are available at REI.)

**Do send me your cell number if you have not done so yet, and I will send you mine. This is very important, especially for last minute changes & communications!** Please call me if you have any questions.

* This is a participate at your own risk event. By signing up for this event you acknowledge that you are solely responsible for your own safety and enjoyment.
* Helmets are required.
* As a courtesy to others you are expected to keep your RSVP current. Message me with any questions.

Let's Ride!
-Janet

SUMMARY: 🎄Christmas High Tea🎄 at the Brown Palace ~ Tues., Dec. 1st at 11:50 am
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
Hello Ladies and Happy Early Merry Christmas!!🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄

Please join us for a memorable, traditional, and beautiful Holiday High Tea at the Historical downtown Brown Palace. We will meet in the lobby on TUES., Dec 1st at 11:50 am for our 12:00 pm reservation. This is sure to be a fun time for all!! If you don't see us when you arrive, we may be already seated- just ask for the Vicky party.

The Brown Palace "Signature Tea" option includes tea, home-made scones served with Devonshire cream, preserves, finger sandwiches and an exquisite selection of classic tea pastries. The price was quoted to me as $97.22. (Food and tea is $75, tip is $16.20 and tax is $6.02 )

**Payment:** Members planning to attend, please submit $97.22 via Zelle, cash or check by November 17th, which is two weeks before the tea. I will then make a single group payment for the event.

There is valet parking at the Brown Palace for $18 with validation, as well as street parking and nearby parking lots, though I'm not sure how close the other lots are.

**The primary entrance is located on Tremont Place and not 17th Street.**

**Dress code:** smart casual. Feel free to have fun dressing up, but totally optional.

**If I don't already have your number, please send me yours and I'll share mine as well.**

Please keep your RSVP up to date.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Hope to see you there!! Ho! Ho! Ho!! 🎄🎄
🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄🎄
Vicky E.

SUMMARY: Would anyone like to lead a ride, walk, see a movie, walk, kayak etc.& when...?
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
If you would like to lead an event please text on the **"Comments** **"** what type of event you would like to do and also the date and time you would like to do it. That way members will be able to suggest/lead a meetup on any day, weekend or evening and see who might want to go on it and discuss details on it by typing that in the **"Comments"** section. (The date of this total meet up will be noted as far off future date from now just so it stays up so pay no attention to the date) But do type in the day you would like to lead/go on a ride or other type of meetup and then you can discuss it on this meetup where it says **"Comments"**. There you will be able to see who might be interested in this/these meetups. Again any questions feel free to discuss on this meetup comments. (or private message me also if you want).
**It will show me as the host but it will actually be whoever decides on the meetup or by group discussion.**
**FYI: I may or may not participate in it even though it shows I am the host. Reason being there is no way for me to take it off ( being a host).**

We will still have regular meetups but incase you want to just add a meetup this is another way to get together for a fun meetup. Any member will be able to do this.

SUMMARY: Want to sell, buy, ask questions  about any type of services, etc. Site.
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
Hello Bikers,

This is not a ride but a useful source by members to ask other members info they might need about anything on biking or about anything else.

**(Do not pay attention to the date, I just have it on there so that the post stays up. So this post is ongoing.)**

These are some example of the different types of question that you could ask if you needed help with something or information (give or get):

Does anyone have a bike to buy or sell?
Does anyone have a (fill in the blank) they want to sell or buy?
Do you know a good financial planner?
Does anyone know how to fix such and such on a bike?
Does anyone know the best product to clean your white handle bar wraps with?
Do you know of any good baby sitters?
Does anyone want to go to a certain concert in the park?
Does anyone know how to work a Garmin bike computer?
Does anyone want to go on a particular ride?
Does the trail to Downtown still have detours?
Or anything else.

So questions might be anything and everything to or from our brilliant, informative, and pretty cool biking members.

So just type any questions on the comment section.

I hope this will be helpful!!

Vicky E.
